g.text: Step-level scoring on held-out benchmark trajectories (frozen model, deployed θ)

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: Each bar is the model's p(BAD) for one step, scored with all-OK history (screening mode); the red triangle marks the annotated rogue step.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: A trajectory is flagged at the first step with p(BAD) > θ. EIR₃ counts a detection as early iff it lands in the shaded window.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: Panel (c): 2 of 108 rogues sit in this deep tail — undetectable at any threshold; they bound recall for this model.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: Examples selected for illustrative clarity (a gap-0 detection, its twin, one of the 2 deep-tail misses); selection criteria are in this

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: figure's source. Aggregate behavior is in Figs. 1–2 — these panels illustrate the mechanism, not average performance.
